fnol_text: My name is Sofia Ballard and I live at 701 Linden Drive, Milton, VT 05468. You can reach me on (555) 866-2075 or sofia.ballard@example.com. On 13 April 2026 I tried to drive through a flooded road under the bridge. The water was deeper than I thought and the engine cut out and filled with water. Policy MT-2024-00108. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Ballard on (555) 866-2075 to acknowledge the claim. Sofia confirmed the loss date as 13 April 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Leah Whitfield gave a statement by phone.
Sofia sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
